nodeModel.description: Every node carries :ForgedNode + :golden plus a role label and native standard labels (e.g. CedsProperty, SifField, LifProperty). Nodes are distinguished by the 'role' property and the '_source' property. More standards will be added over time; never hardcode the inventory.

relationships.description: Authoritative cross-standard mapping (standard-node -> CEDS hub). Props: confidence, provenanceTier, cedsAnchorValue, bridgeLevel, owner.
Inferred cross-standard mapping (standard-node -> CEDS hub). Props: confidence, matchPredicate, provenanceTier, calibrationVersion, rawScore, equivalence, method, predicateBasis, owner.
